## Course data (loads automatically; click to see the code)

R runs inside your browser. The first visit downloads R and the packages, which takes 20–40 seconds; after that the browser caches them. Wait for this block to finish before running exercises.

```{webr}
#| autorun: true
#| edit: false
#| output: false
pkgs <- c("dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "lme4", "lmerTest", "emmeans", "performance", "nlme")
for (p in intersect(pkgs, rownames(installed.packages())))
  suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(p, character.only = TRUE, exclude = if (p == "nlme") "lmList" else NULL))

prep <- function(df) {
  df |> mutate(
    ID     = factor(ID),
    Group  = factor(Group, levels = c("Placebo", "Protein")),
    Sex    = factor(Sex),
    Week_f = factor(Week)
  )
}
img  <- read.csv("data/hypertrophy_images.csv")   |> prep()   # 1 row per ultrasound image
sess <- read.csv("data/hypertrophy_sessions.csv") |> prep()   # 1 row per visit
csa  <- img |>
  group_by(ID, Group, Sex, Week, Week_f) |>
  summarise(VL_CSA_cm2 = mean(VL_CSA_cm2), n_img = n(), .groups = "drop")
csa$Week12  <- csa$Week / 12
sess$Week12 <- sess$Week / 12
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 13))
```
:::
